source_text: Ideo et ego qualitatem rei, quam prioribus scriptis distinguendo a Manichaei ore defendi, nunc quoque breviter criminatorum eius, qui tamen se ei servire profitentur invitos, proditu vindicabo.
pass_a_gloss: Therefore I also will now briefly vindicate the quality of the thing, which in prior writings I defended by distinguishing from the mouth of the Manichaean, by exposing its accusers, who nevertheless profess that they serve it unwilling.

lemmas.lexica: Blaise Manichaeus; Julian's polemic label vs natural evil

pass_b_english: So I too will now briefly vindicate the character of this thing, which in my earlier writings I defended by making distinctions against Mani’s attack, by exposing its accusers—who nevertheless profess that they serve it unwillingly.

choices.why: Julian's standing charge: natural evil is Manichaean. Keep the sect-name, not 'dualists'.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Opus imperfectum contra Iulianum); Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
